# Keel v2

> Tactile, dense admin design system for React 19 — StyleX styling (no Tailwind), Radix behavior, Lucide icons, light/dark tokens via light-dark(), 140+ documented components including chat and AI-agent primitives, and complete page templates.

## Start here
- [Agent skill](skills/keel/SKILL.md): rules and how to build a screen
- [Component catalog](skills/keel/references/components.md): every export with props, generated from source
- [Tokens](skills/keel/references/tokens.md): color, depth, radius, type, motion
- [Styling with StyleX](skills/keel/references/styling.md)
- [Page patterns](skills/keel/references/patterns.md)
- [Setup](skills/keel/references/setup.md)
- [QA checklist](skills/keel/references/qa.md)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo layout and commands

## Source
- [components/](components/): one file per category (action, chat, ai, container, content, feedback, inputs, choice, select, dates, pickers, layout, navigation, overlay, table, lists, data, utility)
- [tokens/tokens.stylex.ts](tokens/tokens.stylex.ts)
- [templates/](templates/): overview, customers, invoices, settings, members, audit-log, assistant, auth
